en: The front side of the postcard shows a natural landscape with a river (likely the Ljungan River) flowing through a lush, forested valley with rolling hills in the background. The colors appear hand-tinted, giving it an early 20th-century look. The text on the front says 'Ljungan vid Johannisberg. 18-9-06.' The reverse side features classic postcard address formatting in Swedish, a Swedish 5 öre stamp, and handwritten text.
